metadata.method_name: AIMD reuse-window caching vs TTL/d-TTL/FreshCache baselines for agent tool calls
metadata.description: Simulated agent tool-call loop over a versioned, volatility-labeled resource corpus, replayed through four cache policies (fixed TTL, d-TTL stochastic-approximation, FreshCache fitted staleness gate [+ pooled variant], and the proposed AIMD reuse-window rule) across volatility regimes and knob grids. No LLM calls used; traces generated in-process (Stage 1 simulator) since no pre-simulated dataset artifact was available.

config.seeds: regime rng seed = 1000 + regime_index; per-job seed = hash((regime, family, knob_index)) % 2**31
